free_tier.stated: 15 GB mail storage, explicitly separate from the 5 GB OneDrive allowance: "You get 15 GB of free Outlook.com email storage which is separate from your Microsoft cloud storage. You have 5 GB of free cloud storage with your Microsoft account shared across your files and photos, attachments in Outlook.com and your Microsoft 365 apps."

retention.stated: Deleted Items counts against quota until emptied or auto-purged at 30 days

egress.terms: Unmetered; no transfer billing on a mailbox.

tooling: IMAP probe-verified: `imap-mail.outlook.com:993` -> `* OK Microsoft Exchange IMAP4 service ready` / `* CAPABILITY IMAP4 IMAP4rev1 AUTH=XOAUTH2 LOGINDISABLED SASL-IR UIDPLUS MOVE ID UNSELECT CHILDREN IDLE NAMESPACE LITERAL+`. Note LOGINDISABLED — OAuth2 only. SMTP probe: `smtp-mail.outlook.com:587` -> `250-SIZE 157286400` (150 MiB) and `250-BINARYMIME`.
chaining: 15 GB × N free Microsoft accounts. Distinct from the A1-education 100 TB tenant finding (already settled in round 1) — this is the consumer path, no tenant needed.
limits_note: per-object-cap governed by `250-SIZE 157286400` = 150 MiB per SMTP message, the largest SMTP SIZE probed in this area. Deleted Items counts against quota until emptied or auto-purged at 30 days. No published IMAP/day byte meter equivalent to Gmail's.
